$description: Semantic type roles over the 16 fluid foundation steps. EVERY value is a rem on a fluid root font-size - see tokens/00-foundation/typography.json ROOT_FONT_SIZE_IS_FLUID before converting anything to px. `usage` counts .u-<step> class occurrences across src/**/*.jsx.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

heading.display.rationale: The largest step (7.5rem base). Used by every h2 section heading and the .list__main__h1 step numerals.

heading.page.rationale: Page-level h1: the hero title, the 404 title and the .list__title-h1 step-list heading.

heading.sub.rationale: The three .ai__subtitle headings and - via an override - the .tech__title on all four tech pages.

heading.minor.rationale: Declared and bound to .u-h4; no element in src/ carries .u-h4, so this role is DEFINED-UNUSED in the markup.

body.lead.rationale: Lead paragraph on the composed tech pages.

body.default.rationale: The .ai__txt supporting paragraphs and the FAQ answers.

body.large.rationale: FAQ question labels and the + / - icon.

label.tag.rationale: Section eyebrow labels: "What you can do", "How It Works", "Trusted By", "FAQs", and the step-list sub-copy.

label.tag-small.rationale: Declared and bound to .u-tag-small; no element in src/ carries it. DEFINED-UNUSED.

label.primary.rationale: Footer primary nav links and the cookie-preference titles.

label.secondary.rationale: Menu/footer secondary links, hero slider items, the .ai__tag text and the cookie body copy.

label.button.rationale: Every .u-btn: all buttons, the header Menu word and the #progress readout.

caption.small.rationale: The three menu group labels ("Menu", "Other", "Social media").

caption.xsmall.rationale: The hero copyright line and the "scroll down" cue.

weight.regular.rationale: h1, h2, body-*, tag, title-3, small-text-*.

weight.medium.rationale: h2-5, h3, h4, title-1, title-2, btn.

label.emphasis.rationale: Menu primary links, the step-slide info copy and the cookie modal title.

usageNote: `usage` is the exact count of the bound .u-<step> class in src/**/*.jsx, counted with the regex (?<![\w-])u-<step>(?![\w-]) so that .u-h2 and .u-h2-5 are never conflated. heading.minor (.u-h4) and label.tag-small (.u-tag-small) are 0: both steps are declared in the stylesheet and bound to a utility class, but no element in src/ carries them.
